verdict.rationale: Paychex's first-party marketing says it automatically calculates, files, and pays payroll taxes. It also says it manages calculation, withholding, and remittance for every state where employees work, which covers the core of automatic tax compliance. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that local taxes are calculated, filed, and remitted (local is mentioned only for law tracking), explicit federal-level detail, in-depth documentation of filing mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have federal, state, and local payroll taxes calculated, filed, and remitted automatically

citations.quote: We automatically calculate, file, and pay your payroll taxes for you.
Paychex automatically manages the calculation, withholding, and remittance of taxes for every state where your employees work
In just one click, Paychex handles direct deposits, tax filings, and pay stubs/checks for your team.
